user.title: Meal Solver 3000
user.description: Enable Meal Solver 3000 to manage the week's dinners.

data_description.max_rules: How many times a tag may appear per week. Format: tag:count — e.g. 'köttfärs:2, fisk:1' means max 2 minced-meat dishes and 1 fish dish per week.
data_description.min_rules: How many times a tag must appear per week. Format: tag:count — e.g. 'vegetarisk:1' requires at least one vegetarian dish.
data_description.no_consecutive: Tags that cannot appear on back-to-back days. E.g. 'potatis, ris, pasta' prevents the same side dish two days in a row.
data_description.repeat_interval: Days a dish must rest before it can be randomized again. E.g. 14 means the same dish won't appear for at least 2 weeks. Set to 0 to disable.
data_description.language: Language used in the Lovelace card. sv = Svenska, en = English.
